text: Messages feel instant and never get lost · ordered, synced across tabs, works offline
originalText: Messages feel instant and never get lost · ordered, synced across tabs, works offline

text:
Key decisions (RADIO)
- Client id per message: show at once,
  swap for server id on ack, dedupe
- Order by server sequence per thread
- Reconnect with backoff, then fetch
  missed messages since last seq
- Virtualized list anchored to bottom
- One socket per browser (leader tab)
